d: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in India for a three-day visit, meeting S Jaishankar in Mumbai to discuss trade, energy and technology, paying tribute to the 26/11 victims, and praising India as a “refining superpower”. Meanwhile, Firstpost examines rising India–Turkey tensions over Ankara’s repeated references to Kashmir, its close ties with Pakistan, and its own disputes over Cyprus, Kurdish rights and Armenia. Hem Kaur Saroya explores whether New Delhi should adopt a tit-for-tat diplomatic strategy and confront Turkey over its own unresolved issues.
